Step3: Extract the AOI values for the candidate countries: Czechia (0.69), United Arab Emirates (0.52), Saint Lucia (0.36), and Qatar (0.11).

Since 2 billion people represent 21.1% of the total population, we can set up the equation: 2,000,000,000 = 0.211 * Total Population.
